intro.fr: Aquaria se joue en multiworld avec Archipelago, qui randomise ses bulbes chantants, urnes et autres emplacements.
intro.en: Aquaria can be played in multiworld with Archipelago, which randomizes its sing bulbs, urns and other locations.

text.fr: Aquaria est jouable en multiworld avec Archipelago. Les emplacements randomisés comprennent notamment tous les bulbes chantants et les urnes de Mithalas.
text.en: Aquaria can be played in multiworld with Archipelago. Randomized locations include all sing bulbs and Mithalas urns, among others.
